scope: Diagnosis only: unchanged formal Core, no alternate optical engine, no native recapture, no product or tolerance edits. Synthetic invariance controls are not native certification.

indexControl.expected: Scaling every refractive index and vacuum wavelength by the same factor preserves ray geometry, phase in waves and image-space diffraction at the same physical positions.

polychromaticControl.model: Axis, constant indices, 450/900nm equal input weights, same pupil and image grids; chromatic chief displacement is zero.

referenceRegistrationControl.scope: Same original Cooke geometry, equal input wavelength weights, no wavelength-square factor on either path. Axis is a positive control; off-axis isolates combining grids with different chief-ray origins. No geometric-centroid shift selected.

transverseOriginControl.scope: All surface frames shifted together in X/Y, no optical prescription change; final-ray controls establish unchanged traced geometry before interpreting diffraction differences.

rows.error: Ray aiming did not converge at stop surface 4 after 1 iterations; residual=∞ mm.
rows.scope: Control fails before diffraction; do not interpret as a wavefront or PSF error.

propagationInputs.scope: Geometry/statistics of inputs used by the existing product coefficient, not an alternate propagator.

energyControl.semantics: Existing formal FFT, centroid and pixel-area integration only. Private Fraction is inspected to reproduce the analysis outside-window behavior; those tails are not coverage certification. Native settings and metrics unchanged. Integer-grid controls isolate presentation resampling, not a proposed product fix.
